sentences.text: This hearing has been done through hybrid mode.

2. The present petition has been filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking issuance of a writ in the nature of mandamus for directing the respondents to pay enhanced compensation with interest towards the subject land situated at Village Molarband, District South East, New Delhi,
acquired vide Award No. 1934-C/Suppl/80-81 dated 6th February, 1981.

3. Vide order dated 13th November, 2024, the Court had directed the Petitioner to place on record,
by way of an affidavit, the application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 that may have been moved by the Petitioner before the concerned authority.
4. The affidavit in terms of the previous order i.e., 13th November, 2024 has not been filed by the Petitioner.
5. None appears for the Petitioner.
Last and final opportunity is granted This is a digitally signed order.
